evidenceKind: primary-source DXF ordering review and generated ASCII/Binary regression
scope: DXF SPLINE control-point and fit-point component order
Focused fast-test and LibreCAD_3 compatibility validation

sources.revision: Published 2023 SPLINE entity and 2024 entity-code guidance

observations.pointGroups: Control points use repeated 10/20/30 components; fit points use repeated 11/21/31 components.
observations.ordering: General entity-code guidance says not to rely on the displayed code order; same-code occurrence order still defines point sequence.

sources.limitation: The schema/order review is not evidence of curve rendering or complete 3D semantic support.

localAudit.reproducedFailure: The old parser opened a control or fit point only when its X group arrived, so earlier Y/Z components were lost or could not be associated.
localAudit.correction: Independent per-axis occurrence cursors assign 10/20/30 and 11/21/31 components by ordinal; existing declared-count and item-cap checks remain in place, and absent Y/Z retain zero defaults.
localAudit.privateStorage: Reuse two pre-existing parser-private pointer slots for cursors with compile-time size/alignment checks; no public member, callback, or virtual was added.
generatedCoverage: Generated ASCII and Binary DXF; no persistent fixture
Control-point and fit-point-only SPLINE records with distinct asymmetric values
Permute coordinate component groups while preserving same-code occurrence order
Assert exact point components and following LINE sentinel

planDelta.nextLocalProbe: MESH component order (now implemented in the companion receipt); then LWPOLYLINE, HATCH/LEADER, and nested MLEADER only after schema-checked generated probes.
planDelta.selfUnblock: Do not wait for optional peers or native consumers; record bounded negative probes and continue through locally testable candidates.

limits.deferredStatus: All six remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
